title.description: A title for the overall system.

description.description: A high level description of the overall system, including all networks and all roles

roles.description: A network is a collection of roles that exchange messages. Multiple roles can coexist in the same network. The simplest network contains a server-client pair.

endpoints.description: A role can declare an endpoint to accept connections from other roles, normally used by servers

payload.description: Must be a valid JSON schema spec. For brevity, openws omits this spec, but implementations should valid this

from.description: A list of roles that can send this message

messages.description: A message accepted by the role and handled by the role, and roles can send messages other roles accepts. The OpenWS spec only defines the shape of the payload, and how things get encoded / decoded on the wire, it doesn't determine behavior (through through description the behavior can be documented).
